record.question: I invited her to __________ any time she was passing, and have a cup of tea.
record.explanation: Answer C: drop in. Drop in means visit casually or briefly, matching the invitation (C). Independent check: “Drop in” means visit someone informally, often briefly, matching “any time she was passing.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/drop-in.
